page: Microsoft Azure EC32eds_v6 is a memory-optimized instance family offering built on the Microsoft Hyper-V virtualization platform. Configured with 32 dedicated vCPUs running on x86_64 Intel processors, the instance delivers a total of 256.0 GB of system memory. This architecture establishes a consistent ratio of 8.0 GB of RAM per vCPU, addressing scenarios where execution threads demand high memory density to prevent process thrashing.

Local hardware integration includes 1888 GB of direct-attached NVMe SSD storage along with support for Azure Premium Storage. The local solid-state drive delivers rapid scratch space and high-throughput temporary storage for intensive read and write workloads. The virtual machine does not provision hardware graphics accelerators, containing zero GPUs, and includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses natively.

With its memory-to-core allocation and local NVMe storage, the EC32eds_v6 is suited for large relational database engines, in-memory caches, data transformation jobs, and big-data analytics. Architectural tradeoffs center on ephemeral storage properties: while the 1888 GB local disk provides high I/O throughput, production setups requiring persistent data durability must rely on attached external storage configurations or application-level replication.
description: The Microsoft Azure EC32eds_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine provisioned on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor and driven by 64-bit x86 Intel processors. Designed for memory-bound and data-dense enterprise workloads, it provides 32 dedicated vCPUs alongside 256.0 GB of RAM, yielding an 8.0 GB per core density. In addition to high-capacity system memory, the instance features 1888 GB of direct-attached local NVMe SSD storage and compatibility with Azure Premium Storage, ensuring rapid I/O throughput for caching and intermediate storage needs. It does not include GPU accelerators, directing its full hardware footprint toward general processing and memory throughput. The balance of 32 dedicated execution threads, substantial RAM, and integrated high-speed local solid-state capacity makes the EC32eds_v6 suitable for in-memory databases, large relational database management systems, data processing pipelines, and memory-heavy analytics workloads.
